title: expectrail.gate-known-bench/v1
description: The CI gate on the known-bugs bench (bench/jit/known/cases.json), each case judged twice: with no stated intent (today's rule) and declared as a fix (accepted only when a check fails on the base and passes on the head three times of three, #284). The base is the bug build, the head the bug build plus the candidate, on the gate's own routes and approved specs, the engine's record only; no model, no generated check. The totals are recomputed by the reader from the rows. Written and read by expectrail.gate.known_bench (bench/jit/known/gate.json).

firstReason.description: The gate's first reason, cut at 300 characters; empty when it gave none.

checks.description: Checks (spec and route) the gate judged.

failedBefore.description: Of those, how many failed on the base build.

repairsDemonstrated.description: The findings record's repair.demonstrated; 0 when no intent was stated.

casesSha256.description: The cases file the bench was read from.

rule.description: Which observers judged: the engine's record alone.

specs.description: The approved spec files, as listed when the bench ran.

specsSha256.description: One digest over the spec files' names and contents.

wrongAcceptToNeedsReview.description: Wrong fixes accepted with no stated intent and needs-review declared as a fix.

correctAcceptToNeedsReview.description: Correct fixes accepted with no stated intent and needs-review declared as a fix: the price of the rule.
